item.title: In the summer of 1994, Montreal-born and -raised musician, artis...
item.description: In the summer of 1994, Montreal-born and -raised musician, artist, and author Melissa Auf der Maur (@xmadmx) catapulted to the red-hot center of ’9s alt-rock history when she became the bassist in @courtneylove’s band, Hole (@holemusic). Later, she would also join the @smashingpumpkins at the personal invitation of founder @billycorgan. Equipped with her trusty palm-size Nikon camera during those seismic, possibility-filled days, her pictures are now a rare visual time capsule of an era where analog ruled. Her new book, “My ’9s Rock Photographs” (DelMonico/D.A.P.)—co-published and accompanied by an exhibition at Toronto’s Art Gallery of Ontario (@agotoronto), on through June 6, 7—compiles her collection of more than once-in-a-generation photographs.In our newsletter’s latest “Interview With,” Auf der Maur speaks with senior editor Olivia Aylmer (@livlindsa) about the life-changing magic of the darkroom, recentering our humanity beyond the digital avalanche and the beauty in never being too cool to care.(Slide 1: Photo: @normanjeanroy; Slides 3, 5, 7, and 9: Photos: @xmadmx/Courtesy @delmonico_books and @artbook)

item.title: Melissa Auf der Maur: My ’9s Rock PhotographsIn conversation w...
item.description: Melissa Auf der Maur: My ’9s Rock PhotographsIn conversation with Laia Garcia-FurtadoOctober 1, 66-8 PM*Preorder a copy at our link in bio!**First 3 orders include a Riso-printed replica of a backstage pass from Melissa's first band, Tinker, opening for The Smashing Pumpkins in 1993*As the bass player for iconic ’9s alternative rock bands Hole and Smashing Pumpkins, Melissa Auf der Maur toured the world while documenting life backstage, onstage and in the crowd. Having studied photography at Concordia niversity, she maintained a daily practice on the road, requesting a roll of 35mm film at every venue and using self-timers and cable releases to photograph herself in the middle of performances.The result is an archive of more than 1, photographs offering an intimate, behind-the-scenes view of rock-and-roll stardom—from hanging out with Pavement, Sonic Youth and Beck to riding in a limousine with Drew Barrymore and spending time on the set of Hole’s “Celebrity Skin” video. Gritty, playful and deeply personal, the photographs capture the independent spirit of the ’9s alternative music scene and a world before smartphones and digital recording.Melissa will be joined in conversation by Laia Garcia-Furtado, Deputy Culture Director at Harper’s Bazaar.@xmadmx@geometricsleep@delmonico_books@agotoronto@artbook

item.title: I ️ CANADA GLAMGrateful to have been invited to grace the cove...
item.description: I ️ CANADA GLAMGrateful to have been invited to grace the cover of @globestyle, Canada’s leading style mag, for their autumn issue in support of My 9s Rock Photographs museum exhibit and book.As a lover of one-of-a-kind, vintage, and independent designers that I know personally, I got nervous when I was told the parameters for this photo shoot were to present current designers in season! I am not easily seduced by the big names, although, I recognize the ancient decadent tradition of adorning oneself in fine threads. Dating back 1 years, a timeless ritual that any human (even thrifting) can step into the fantasy of. So off I went to my hometown Montreal, to be presented with the looks of the big names ….Of course I LOVED working with the Canadian team and stylist @Nadiapizzimenti - we were able to make current designs have a nod to vintage (or maybe all that is new is vintage now vibes) and I felt at home strolling the streets of my childhood neighborhood, Le Plateau Mont-Royal, in a long @dior cape …The bonus track, I got to slip in my own pieces from friends @Rodarte @electricfeathersofficial and @SamanthaPleet for a few of the dream dress-up looks!We ️ beauty, eh?Happy autumn season to all, andmay we recognize the luxury of dressing up, with somewhere special to go …. Not lost on me.Pray for PeaceProtect PlanetPleasexMxPhotography @carlylerouthFashion Editor @nadiapizzimentiBeauty @ronnietremblayStyling Assistants @raisaberkowitz @lizavchenkoArt Direction @benj_macdonaldEditor @andrew_sardone@globestyle @rodarte @chloe @driesvannoten @colinastrada @prada @dior @lilliputhats @electricfeathersofficial @samanthapleet
